# Gearky

> Gearky is an independent buyer's guide for PlayStation accessories, storage upgrades, console decisions, and deals. Honest reviews tested by real players.

## About

Gearky publishes hands-on reviews and buying guides for PS5 and PS4 controllers, accessories, SSD storage upgrades, console skins and the used market, plus discount codes and game recommendations. We are reader-supported through affiliate commissions (Amazon Associates) and are not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment.
